description.zh: 在这台电脑上运行 AI 模型，断网也能用：“翻译”选“本地模型”就能离线翻译，“按意思找”选“本地模型”就能离线按意思找文件，内容不出本机。可一键下载推荐的模型，也可以导入自己的 .gguf 模型文件（Ollama、LM Studio 下好的都行）。有显卡就用显卡，没有就用 CPU；不用时自动释放内存
description.en: Runs an AI model on this computer, with no network needed: set Translate's service to Local model to translate offline, or Search by meaning's to find files by meaning offline, and nothing leaves this PC. Download a recommended model in one click, or use a .gguf model file of your own (from Ollama or LM Studio too). The GPU when there is one, else the CPU; the memory is freed when idle

network:listen: TCP 39281，只有本机能连（127.0.0.1） / TCP 39281, this computer only (127.0.0.1)

files:read: 你选的模型文件（.gguf） / The model files you choose (.gguf)

description.zh: 看本地模型的状态，下载模型、释放内存
description.en: The local model's state; download a model, free the memory

hint.zh: 推荐的模型在上面的卡片上点“下载”，从 ModelScope 下载（国内快），下好后断网也能用
hint.en: For a recommended model click Download on the card above: it comes from ModelScope and works offline from then on

title.zh: Qwen3.5 2B（通用，翻译、问答都行，1.2 GB）
混元 HY-MT1.5 1.8B（腾讯的翻译模型，只做翻译，1.1 GB）
title.en: HY-MT1.5 1.8B (Tencent's translation model, translation only, 1.1 GB)

hint.zh: 上面选“自己的模型文件”时用。要对话模型（文件名常带 Instruct、Chat 或 it），2B–8B、Q4_K_M 的较合适；mmproj 文件不行，嵌入模型选到最下面的“嵌入模型文件”里
hint.en: For “My own model file” above. A chat model (Instruct, Chat or it in the name); 2B–8B at Q4_K_M suits most PCs. Not an mmproj file; an embedding model goes under Embedding model file at the bottom

hint.zh: NVIDIA、AMD、Intel 显卡都行（Vulkan）；显存不够时自动改用 CPU
hint.en: NVIDIA, AMD or Intel (Vulkan); the CPU instead when the GPU has too little memory

title.en: Use it when there is one (faster)

hint.zh: 模型加载后要占 1–2 GB 内存，这么久没用到就释放；下次用到时再加载，要几秒
hint.en: A loaded model takes 1–2 GB of memory: it is let go of after this long unused, and loaded again (a few seconds) when needed

hint.zh: 别的程序可以用 http://127.0.0.1:端口/v1 调用模型（OpenAI 兼容，模型名随意），只有本机能连
hint.en: Other programs can use the model at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1 (OpenAI-compatible, any model name); only this computer can connect

hint.zh: “按意思找”把模型服务选成“本地模型”时用它：建索引和查找都在本机算，不上传。只用翻译的话不用管，也不用下载
hint.en: Used when Search by meaning's model service is Local model: indexing and searching are computed on this PC, nothing is uploaded. Not needed (nor downloaded) for translation alone

hint.zh: 上面选“自己的模型文件”时用。要嵌入模型，比如 bge-m3、Qwen3-Embedding；换了模型，“按意思找”会重新建索引
hint.en: For “My own model file” above. An embedding model such as bge-m3 or Qwen3-Embedding; after a change Search by meaning builds its index again
